title: The One Thing to Know About Monitoring

scenes.say: Ever wonder what really matters in monitoring? Let’s break down the one thing you need to know.

scenes.label: Signals
scenes.sub: Latency, traffic, errors, and saturation—the four golden signals.
scenes.say: It all starts with the four golden signals: latency, traffic, errors, and saturation. These tell you if users are happy, or if something’s breaking.
Metrics are your first alert—numbers over time. Logs and traces fill in the story when you need details or to follow a request.
Prometheus pulls your metrics, checks alert rules, and fires off alerts. Grafana makes it all visible. Alertmanager gets the right team involved.

scenes.question: What’s the biggest alerting mistake?
scenes.right: Alert only on symptoms users notice, not every tiny blip.
scenes.say: Here’s where people slip up: they alert on every metric change. The real trick? Only alert on symptoms users would notice, not every blip.
